## Notion Business plan up 33%
Notion raised Business from $15 to $20/mo per seat on 2025-06-03 [1]. A 20-seat team pays roughly $1,200/yr more. Separately, a $10/mo Notion AI add-on tier appeared in May [0] and was withdrawn by September [4], suggesting AI was either bundled into base plans or pulled back — worth confirming with Notion before assuming it's gone.

## Linear raises two tiers on the same day
On 2025-11-12, Linear raised Basic from $8 to $10/mo (+25%) [5] and Business from $14 to $16/mo (+14%) [6] simultaneously — a coordinated, company-wide price update rather than a single-tier tweak.

## Postman overhauls its paid tier lineup
On 2026-04-02, Postman removed Basic ($19/mo) [8] and Professional ($39/mo) [9], replacing them with Solo ($9/mo flat, 1 seat) [10] and Team ($19/mo per seat) [11]. Team's price matches old Basic, but there's no direct successor to the $39 Professional tier — customers there face a downgrade to Team or an upsell to enterprise.

## Postman squeezes free tier seats twice
Postman's Free tier went from unlimited/unspecified seats to a 3-seat cap in August 2025 [2], then to just 1 seat in April 2026 [7] — two tightenings in eight months, pushing small teams toward paid plans.

## Notion shifts free tier to per-seat billing
Notion's Free tier moved from flat to per-seat billing on 2025-09-01 [3], the same date its AI add-on was removed [4]. Free tier costs now scale with team size rather than staying fixed.
